5686-7084-8337.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, M'Ress triggers, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

4896-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with different powers.
4896-8190.notes: Alternate adding {W} and {U} each loop, starting with the color you do not provide to begin.

4695-6735-8089.description:
Activate Soul Channeling by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1379-4017-4186-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1379-4017-4186-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Scurry Oak triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-3081-3817-7772.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Valiant Changeling.
When Valiant Changeling dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Valiant Changeling from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

5078-5741-7729.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat

661-2510-3685-4659.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
661-2510-3685-4659.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {1} due to Semblance Anvil. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

283-4067-7132.easyPrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
Your deck size is 8 or greater.
283-4067-7132.description:
Activate Super-Skrull's fourth ability by paying {5}{U}, targeting yourself.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Super-Skrull's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both abilities, causing you to draw eight cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 until you have at least {5}{U} in your mana pool.
Repeat from step 1.

774-5233-6763.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When Boros Garrison enters, it triggers.
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Boros Garrison's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3536-4659-4907-6989.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker, triggering its ability. Choose to name "Tatterkite".
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {2} due to Cheering Fanatic. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Tatterkite, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 2.

240-997-1879-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2457-4094-4289-7175.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

2963-6913-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
2963-6913-7009.description:
Activate Chameleon using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Chameleon. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

4446-4771-5220-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Cleric.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
4446-4771-5220-6900.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1681-3967-4140.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Twilight Shepherd.
When Twilight Shepherd dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Giada.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2011-2097-4076.easyPrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos.
2011-2097-4076.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it.
Najeela and Burakos triggers.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Burakos trigger, creating five Treasure tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose 4 life.
Activate the five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

1981-4416-4716-6740.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 3.
You control two untapped Soldiers.
1981-4416-4716-6740.description:
Declare Phyrexian Vindicator as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Catapult Squad by tapping two Soldiers, attempting to deal 2 damage to Phyrexian Vindicator.
The damage is prevented due to Phyrexian Vindicator's replacement effect. Phyrexian Vindicator triggers, dealing 2 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1486-1744-2972-4600.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Ganax.
When the Ganax tokens enter the battlefield, each Ganax triggers five times, creating 25 Treasure tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for a Dragon card and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, each Ganax triggers, creating six Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3 until you have no Dragons remaining in your library.
1486-1744-2972-4600.notes: This combo will make some extra Treasures which you may use to activate Magda's ability a few extra times to fetch a few artifacts.

1339-2396-6096.notablePrerequisites:
Ophidian Eye attached to General Kreat.
You have a way to draw a card.
1339-2396-6096.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering General Kreat, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Ophidian Eye triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

38-301-5663.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-301-5663.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {R}.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, Cayth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Repeat.

2035-2523-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Gollum.
When Gollum dies, it and Ratadrabik trigger.
Resolve the Ratadrabik trigger, creating a  nonlegendary token copy of Gollum that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Gollum trigger from step 2, causing the Ring to tempt you, and for the Gollum token to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

2511-4871-5433.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure.
2511-4871-5433.description:
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Goblin token.
When the Goblin dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2634-3669-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
2634-3669-4276.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Turnabout.
Resolve the copy of Turnabout, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

345-4214-5189.notablePrerequisites:
A creature you control has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
"Saproling" chosen with Metallic Mimic.
345-4214-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Utopia Mycon's second ability by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
Resolve the Ghave ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1624-1859-3625-3646.manaNeeded: {4}{G}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1624-1859-3625-3646.notablePrerequisites: Tree of Redemption does not have summoning sickness.
1624-1859-3625-3646.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Storvald either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{G}{W}{U} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Storvald enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing Tree or Redemption's power and toughness to become 1 until end of turn.
Activate Tree of Redemption by tapping it, causing your life total to become 1.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

1202-4316-5147-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Myr Moonvessel trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Moonvessel on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Myr Moonvessel from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

3277-3603-5195.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Izzet Chronarch
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Izzet Chronarch
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloudshift to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

512-3990-4241.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that can tap to produce {W}.
512-3990-4241.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Halo Fountain to become a creature.
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Incubation Druid, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

647-3259-4373.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-4373.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ghalta and Mavren as attackers.
Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1280-4447.notablePrerequisites:
Assault Suit attached to Marjhan.
A player controls no Islands.
1280-4447.description:
If needed, give control of Marjhan to an opponent who controls no Islands.
When Marjhan's controller controls no Islands, Marjhan triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Marjhan cannot be sacrificed due to Assault Suit.
Marjhan triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

914-1309-1980-3130.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least eight artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1309-1980-3130.description:
Cast Blue Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{U}{U}, targeting Salvager of Secrets.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, creating a copy of Blue Sun's Twilight, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Resolve the copy of Blue Sun's Twilight, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist.
The Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Resolve the original Blue Sun's Twilight from step 1, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets.
The Salvager of Secrets token enters the battlefield, returning Blue Sun's Twilight from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target Salvager of Secrets and any other creature to get infinite copies of any creature on the battlefield.

1283-2179-4131.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {3}.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Basalt Monolith's last ability.
Resolve the copy of Basalt Monolith's last ability, untapping it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Basalt Monolith ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

3249-3661-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Shield Sphere, adding {R}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Shield Sphere.
Cast Shield Sphere from graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.
